current.scope: Revenue observations only; expenses/free flow/repayment outcomes uncalibrated. Dependent revised-vintage series; reported empirical coverage, not a guaranteed borrower confidence level.

improved.scope: Revenue observations only; expenses/free flow/repayment outcomes uncalibrated. Dependent revised-vintage series; reported empirical coverage, not a guaranteed borrower confidence level.

external_interval_diagnostic.scope: 68 previously consumed external-audit windows; excluded from residual calibration, not fresh confirmatory evidence.

limitations: Aggregate nominal turnover and NZ electronic card-spend proxy; no real expenses, repayment or default outcomes.
Fresh provider/sector labels are revised-vintage retrospective measurements, not historical-vintage prospective validation.
Earlier terminal and temporal labels were explicitly consumed development evidence.
Only one frozen upgrade configuration was evaluated on final targets; no post-final tuning or threshold relaxation.
Raw CAD and NZD values are never pooled as money or used as borrower currency without conversion.

paired_annual_block_interval.limitation: Nine revised-vintage annual blocks and two countries; paired year draws retain within-year cross-country shocks. Serial and survey-revision dependence can remain; no independent-borrower or prospective guarantee.

reservation.limitations: New provider/sector label reservation in a current revised vintage; historical eras overlap training countries. Annual national panels have macroeconomic dependence. Whole-year bootstrap describes these reserved blocks, not a prospective independent-country confidence interval or borrower accuracy.

statcan_wholesale.bootstrap_grouping: provider plus annual target-start year; all industries in a year stay together
statcan_wholesale.selection_rule: All 13 provinces/territories sorted by sha256('20261011|' + geography name); first max(3,ceil(n/3)) geographies wholly audit-only, all others chronological fit/dev/latest holdout. All 32 disjoint deepest published NAICS leaves retained before completeness exclusions.

statsnz.bootstrap_grouping: provider plus annual target-start year; all industries in a year stay together
statsnz.selection_rule: All eight disjoint published leaf industries; NZ never enters training or development.

sources.attribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, Table 20-10-0074-01 Wholesale trade, sales, July 2026. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
sources.limitations: Canada and Statistics Canada already appear in the previous RETAIL corpus; these WHOLESALE labels and industry taxonomies are new, not a new independent country/provider. National parent aggregates and geographic totals excluded. Provinces share revisions and macroeconomic shocks. Northwest Territories included Nunavut before 1999, so this overlapping pre-1999 Northwest Territories history is made unusable. Monthly unadjusted estimates revised back to 2012 with the May 2017 sample change; current-vintage histories are not historical vintages. Oilseed/grain and petroleum detailed reporting starts 2023. No borrower revenue, expense, repayment or default labels.
sources.published_status_policy: Numeric A excellent/B very good/C good/D acceptable/E use with caution and unflagged/provisional/revised published values accepted, matching existing Canadian retail quality policy. F unreliable, x confidential, .. missing and absent calendar cells remain null, never zero. E is retained with its original flag, never relabelled high quality.
sources.source_availability_note: US Census direct XLSX/bulk downloads returned 403 and the API requires a key. FRED redistribution was excluded because its current terms prohibit software/system/ML development or training. Singapore data researched only as an alternative and not used. No model scores drove this source substitution.
sources.taxonomy_policy: All 32 numeric deepest published NAICS leaves, no selected ancestor/descendant pair. Exclusion subtotal codes and national Canada total omitted. All 13 nonoverlapping provinces/territories retained before missing-window exclusions. Calendar gaps before a category exists are explicit null; newer leaves may have only recent eligible cases.
sources.title: Statistics Canada Table 20-10-0074-01 Wholesale trade, sales; unadjusted province/territory deepest disjoint NAICS leaves
sources.units: thousand CAD, current prices, not seasonally adjusted
